meta.title: Goose Trouble Studio — Mobile Game Studio
meta.description: Goose Trouble Studio is an independent studio making mobile detective games full of murder cases, dark rooms and hidden clues. Run your giveaway in seconds with Feedzi.
meta.ogDescription: Mobile detective and mystery games. Play. Investigate. Discover.
hero.lead: Goose Trouble Studio makes mobile games where Trouble Goose always ends up in trouble. We also built a giveaway tool called Feedzi.
hero.mascotAlt: Trouble Goose: the mascot with orange goggles, headphones and a black hoodie
games.title: What’s hatching?
games.lead: Our freshly hatched games. More details as they leak.
games.file.desc: A murder file and scattered evidence. Examine every detail, connect the pieces, solve the case.
games.afterlight.desc: A mystery that begins after the lights go out. Hunt for clues in dark rooms.
games.next.title: Next file
games.next.desc: Sealed. That’s all we can say for now.
games.ios: “When’s iOS?” The goose doesn’t have a MacBook. The piggy bank is filling up; once it’s full, we’re flying straight to the App Store.
studio.imgAlt: Goose Trouble Studio logo with Trouble Goose drinking coffee
studio.title: The team behind the goose
studio.lead: We’re a small team that loves mystery, suspense and that “just one more clue” feeling. Our games have a dark atmosphere; our goose stays as cheeky as ever.
studio.f1.title: Designed for mobile
studio.f1.desc: Every case is built from scratch for Android: tap, zoom, inspect, interrogate.
studio.f2.title: Character-driven
studio.f2.desc: Every game carries Trouble Goose’s mark. Genres change; the goose’s character doesn’t.
studio.f3.title: Beyond games
studio.f3.desc: We also build handy web tools for content creators and brands.
tool.title: Run your giveaway, let the goose pick the winner.
tool.lead: Paste the post link, set your rules, pick a fair and random winner. No spreadsheets, no screen recordings, no “was it rigged?” debates.
tool.step1: Paste the link. Add the link to your giveaway post.
tool.step2: Set the rules. Tag count, duplicate comments, backup winners.
tool.step3: Announce the winner. Share the results screen with your followers.
tool.mock.note: This is a demo. Open the tool for a real giveaway.
contact.title: Got an idea? The goose is listening.
contact.lead: Write to us about partnerships, press, and feedback from players and tool users.
